entries.en: heaven, paradise; the glory (bliss) of heaven

entries.zh: 品评、品鉴；品第、等级；（西语词头谓因某事自得、自夸）
entries.en: to appraise, to rank, to grade; per the Spanish headword: to take pride or glory in something
entries.notes: 词头缩写"f. ruam."不可解，西语义与汉字“品”对应存疑，以 H/M 为主要依据、兼录西语义

entries.en: glory; heavenly bliss or blessing (probable 福; uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字栏空缺，据 L“Glorias”与 M“hog”（与“福”音合）推断，同音字多歧无法锁定用字

entries.en: to govern, to rule; to administer

entries.en: to govern, to be in charge of; palm of the hand
lord, master; to dominate, to rule

entries.en: to govern as a superior or magistrate; to preside over, to have charge of

entries.zh: 管理、掌管（对自有产业而言）；管束
entries.en: to manage, to administer (as one's own property); to keep in charge
power, authority; to rule over a dominion
to grasp, to hold in one's power; to control, to wield
entries.notes: R 栏局部污损（T99），据 H“掌握”与西语 gouernar 释义
